SELECT jsonb_build_object(
'load_balancers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',lb_id,'tenant_id',tenant_id,'state',state,'configuration_state',configuration_state)) FROM network_load_balancers WHERE state<>'deleted'),
'vpcs',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',vpc_id,'tenant_id',tenant_id,'state',state)) FROM network_vpcs WHERE state<>'deleted'),
'subnets',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',subnet_id,'tenant_id',tenant_id,'state',state)) FROM network_subnets WHERE state<>'deleted'),
'attachments',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',attachment_id,'tenant_id',tenant_id,'state',state,'pod_name',pod_name,'pod_uid',pod_uid)) FROM network_attachments WHERE state<>'released'),
'eips',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',eip_id,'tenant_id',tenant_id,'state',state,'scope',scope,'address',address)) FROM network_eips WHERE state<>'deleted'),
'snats',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',snat_id,'tenant_id',tenant_id,'state',state,'purpose',purpose,'eip_id',eip_id,'desired_enabled',desired_enabled,'applied_enabled',applied_enabled)) FROM network_snat_bindings WHERE state<>'deleted'),
'active_claims',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('eip_id',eip_id,'tenant_id',tenant_id,'target_kind',target_kind,'lb_id',lb_id,'snat_id',snat_id,'state',state)) FROM network_eip_claims WHERE released_at IS NULL)
);
